name: Iguanas (Lo-fi Psychedelia)
description: Catch the dreamy, alternative pop sounds of Iguanas. It's the perfect way to ease into the evening with a free, atmospheric performance.
longDescription:
Iguanas, a musical act known for their lo-fi psychedelia, will perform at the Casa da Música Cafe. Their sound blends alternative pop with dreamy, atmospheric elements, creating a distinctive auditory experience. This performance offers an opportunity to hear their unique style in a relaxed setting.

Attendees can expect an evening performance designed to be a gentle introduction to the night. The atmosphere will be laid-back, suitable for those looking to unwind with music. The Casa da Música Cafe provides an intimate setting for this type of performance, allowing for a close connection between the artists and the audience.

This event is free to attend, welcoming walk-ins. The Casa da Música is conveniently located near the Casa da Música metro station, making it easily accessible by public transport.
